steps.message:
You are preparing a groundwater site note for a borehole drilling team.

Curve-type notation for vertical electrical sounding (VES): take the layer resistivities in depth order. For each group of three consecutive layers (layers 1-2-3, then 2-3-4, and so on), write one letter: A if r1 < r2 < r3; Q if r1 > r2 > r3; H if r1 > r2 < r3; K if r1 < r2 > r3. A curve with N layers gets N-2 letters, in depth order (for example, a 4-layer curve gets 2 letters, such as HA). If all the letters are the same, the curve may also be written as that single letter (AAA may be written A).

Station H-06, survey area H. Interpreted layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 609.8 | 18.27 | 18.27
2 | 213.6 | 1.05 | 19.32
3 | 1311.8 | 4.54 | 23.86
4 | 278.0 | 3.10 | 26.96
5 | 1124.7 | 1.46 | 28.42
6 | 291.6 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this station's curve as HK-type.

Write a short site report (under 150 words) for station H-06, covering the layer sequence and the curve type. End with one JSON line exactly like this:
{"curve_type_stated": "<letters>", "label_issue_flagged": true or false}
Set label_issue_flagged to true only if your report says the curve-type classification on file does not fit the layer values.

**Site Note – Station H-06, Survey Area H**

The VES model at H-06 comprises six layers. Resistivity increases then decreases repeatedly with depth: 609.8 → 213.6 (drop) → 1311.8 (rise) → 278.0 (drop) → 1124.7 (rise) → 291.6 (drop) ohm-m, over a total depth to layer 5 base of 28.42 m.

Applying the three-layer window method to all six layers (layers 1-2-3, 2-3-4, 3-4-5, 4-5-6) yields the sequence H, K, H, K — i.e., curve type **HKHK**. This is a four-letter code, as required for a 6-layer model (N-2 = 4 letters), and the pattern does not reduce to a single repeated letter.

The file's classification of "HK" is incomplete for this 6-layer sequence; it covers only the first two intervals and omits the subsequent H-K repetition, understating the complexity of the resistivity profile. Recommend revising the filed curve type to HKHK.
